from pathlib import Path
import json
files=sorted(p for name in ['alpha','beta','gamma'] if (p:=Path(name+'.md')).exists())
with Path('verify-runs.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps([p.name for p in files])+'\n')
for p in files:assert p.read_text()==p.stem+'\n',p
print('All existing fixture documents have expected content:', ', '.join(p.name for p in files))
